cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the sentence you deleted, not another 'fine.' Complete wording, please; I want to know what you're trusting me with.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the need in. Don't edit out the part I need to answer. Send it to me as you wrote it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check for your reply before I get out of bed. No 'just checking,' no smiley face. Now send me your sentence without apologising for it.

reason: Make exact-message editing expertise the way A invites emotional risk, while B reciprocity demand forces A own specific vulnerable disclosure.
